Fertility Nuts
By: jen
Published: Friday, February 12, 2010 - 1:40am

Ingredients




tablespoon Butter
2 teaspoons Dried Rosemary
1 teaspoon Salt
teaspoon Cayenne Pepper
2 cups Walnuts

Preparation

1 Melt butter with the 2 teaspoons crumbled, dried rosemary, salt and cayenne pepper. 2 Pour the mixture over the walnuts, tossing to coat them. 3 Bake the nuts on a cookie sheet at 250 degrees for 10 minutes. 4 They may be served before or after a meal for a finishing touch. I set these out every Christmas Eve for my champagne/seafood open house buffet and they're gone in a few hours. 5 Serves: Never enough 6 NOTES : These came through with this name. I would love to know why. Kathy 7 how much butter?
